Alice — thanks, and congrats to the team. Attaching a baseline MAP (RW-MAP-AeroTech-v1.2.pdf) and a short canary runbook (canary-runbook.xlsx). The baseline embeds the evaluation plan and a recommended training cadence; key highlights below: 

- Proposed timeline (draft):
  • Week 1 (Apr 7–11): Preflight & infra prep (networking, credentials, KMS key exchange)
  • Week 2 (Apr 14–18): Canary week — 1% traffic, controlled test harness, metrics gate checks
  • Week 3 (Apr 21–25): Gradual ramp to 25% with rollback rehearsals
  • Week 4 (Apr 28–May 2): Full cutover target (business hours cutover with fallback window)

- Migration window: recommended weekend cutover (Sat 4/26 — Sun 4/27) for DB switch and config toggle; we include a fallback plan that reverts to current routing if SLOs degrade >5% sustained over 15m.

- Evaluation plan (canary acceptance criteria):
  • Latency p50/p95 within agreed SLA (p95 <= 350ms)
  • Error rate < 0.5% sustained during test window
  • Functional regression tests (top 20 prompts) pass with no quality degradation > 2% per eval suite

- Training: ops runbooks and 2 live sessions for SRE + support (dates proposed in training-schedule.csv). We recommend the first session during Canary week and a follow-up at Ramp.

Attachments: RW-MAP-AeroTech-v1.2.pdf (MAP), canary-runbook.xlsx (runbook with smoke checks), training-schedule.csv (proposed instructor-led sessions).

Notes: no company-wide blackout days on Redwood side in April, but our infra team is observing a brief maintenance window Apr 2 for an unrelated upgrade — shouldn't affect the proposed dates.

If you want I can run a 30-min walkthrough with Ben and your IT lead early next week.

Thanks,

Looping in a few technical confirmations (see inline):

- Load generator & cluster: We'll use test-cluster-07 for canary runs. Runbook step #4 will start the generator with a 30m ramp then steady 1% simulated traffic for 4 hours.
- KV warmup: we will pre-populate KV caches during the preflight window; runbook includes a scripted step to validate hit-rate.
- Monitoring gates: Prometheus alerts + tracing span rate checks. If p95 increases >20% relative to baseline for 3 consecutive 5m windows, automatic abort and rollback.
- Canary window timing: propose Apr 15 02:00–06:00 PT for the initial 1% injection (low production impact). If that doesn't work for AeroTech ops, we can shift to Apr 16 same window.

I updated canary-runbook.xlsx and pushed the change to the Drive link. Also added a short migration checklist for the weekend cutover (config toggles, DNS TTL plan).
